fields.name: asin
fields.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), supports multiple (max 10), comma-separated. Example: B0088PUEPK or B0088PUEPK,B00U26V4VQ

fields.name: marketplace
fields.description: Amazon site code: us, gb, de, fr, in, ca, jp, es, it, mx, ae, au, br, sa

fields.name: includeTrend
fields.description: Whether to include trend data. 1: include (default); 2: exclude

fields.name: queryTrendStartDate
fields.description: Trend start date, format yyyy-MM-dd. Default returns only the last 15 days; querying more than 15 days doubles the cost
